title: Split an amount by ratios with largest-remainder distribution
contract: Converts the amount to whole cents (at most two decimals), gives each party floor(cents*ratio/totalRatio), then hands leftover cents one each by largest fractional remainder, ties by lowest index. Zero ratios get nothing and no leftover. Results have scale 2 and sum exactly to the input. Null/negative/over-precise amounts and null/empty/negative/zero-sum ratios throw IllegalArgumentException.
expectedValuesFrom: Allocations computed independently in Python integer arithmetic, not by running Solution.
